question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: Bellicose
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Warlike .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Bellicose** means demonstrating aggression or willingness to fight.
 
• The correct synonym of **Bellicose** is **Warlike**, which also refers to being combative or eager to engage in conflict.
 
• The other options do not match the meaning of the given word:
 
 
• **Peaceful:** Opposite in meaning to Bellicose.
 
• **Amiable:** Means friendly and pleasant, which is unrelated to aggression.
 
• **Timid:** Refers to being shy or lacking confidence, which is also opposite in meaning to Bellicose.
 
 

Correct Sentence: *The most appropriate synonym of Bellicose is **Warlike***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms:** Words with similar meanings.
 
 
• **Example:** Angry - Furious, Mad, Irritated.
 
 
 
• **Antonyms:** Words with opposite meanings.
 
 
• **Example:** Happy - Sad, Miserable, Upset.
